error.message:
invalid registry at /home/me/dev/repos.toml:
  repo `kit` sits under `sveltejs`, not an owner — a third-party clone belongs in [references]
  reference `wpt` sets `upstream` but its url isn't owned — a fork is an owned repo
  repo `app` has dir `../app`, which isn't a plain name — an entry's dir is one directory under the workspace root
  reference `app-ref` claims dir `app`, already claimed by repo `app`
  `gro` is both a repo and a reference
  key `site` is the dir of repo `www` — a target naming it is ambiguous
  repo `app` requires `nope`, which is neither a repo nor a reference
  repo `app` consults itself
  repo `app` both requires and consults `gro` — pick one
error.hint: fix each issue in the registry; nothing is probed until it validates
